source: API v1 inventory and Backend main 6a4f913...

cases.title: Local login, session check and logout
cases.actor: Pre-provisioned user (STAFF / REGISTRATION_ADMIN / SYSTEM_ADMIN / OWNER / RETENTION_WORKER)
cases.pre: Account exists and ACTIVE; server-side pepper and idle-timeout setting are configured; protected API explicitly enabled only in isolated staging.
cases.success: Issue only an opaque session token to client; store token digest in vc_sessions; validate role and session per protected call; revoke on logout.
cases.failure: Unknown/suspended user, password mismatch, retry limit, expired/idle/revoked session return safe denial; username enumeration timing remains under review.
cases.notes: Login reads vc_security_events for 15-minute failed-attempt limit (6 failures). The actual GAS implementation creates a server session, but protected public /exec remains gated.
cases.requirement: APPROVED_REQUIREMENTS_BASELINE_R01_R26.md (section-level mapping; no unverified R number asserted)

cases.title: First-login password change and administrator reset
cases.pre: User is pre-provisioned and has an active session; password_change_required may be set. System Admin has users.manage for resets.
cases.success: Verify old password, write new PBKDF2 hash, clear first-login flag, revoke all sessions; admin reset sets flag again and revokes sessions.
cases.failure: Wrong old password or insufficient permission fails; admin-reset error does not create a new session. Abrupt Sheets partial writes need review.
cases.notes: First login can use auth.session, auth.logout and auth.changePassword while other protected business operations are blocked.
cases.requirement: APPROVED_REQUIREMENTS_BASELINE_R01_R26.md (section-level mapping; no unverified R number asserted)

cases.title: Google identity linking and pre-provisioned Google sign-in
cases.actor: Authenticated account holder / linked Google identity
cases.pre: A locally authenticated account exists for linking; Google OIDC client audience and trusted verifier configured.
cases.success: Verified Google subject (sub) is linked uniquely to an existing user; later login issues server-side session only for that linked ACTIVE account.
cases.failure: Unknown/unlinked sub, invalid Google token, reused sub, wrong local password or disabled user fails; no Google auto-provisioning.
cases.notes: Google token validation uses UrlFetchApp to Google tokeninfo and must check audience, issuer, expiry, email_verified. OIDC live provider test is not yet verified.
cases.requirement: APPROVED_REQUIREMENTS_BASELINE_R01_R26.md (section-level mapping; no unverified R number asserted)

cases.title: User provisioning, maintenance, suspension and role assignment
cases.pre: System Admin has users.manage; username and roles meet allowlist; server session active.
cases.success: Create a STAFF account with temporary password, edit profile, assign valid roles, suspend account, revoke sessions, write change audit.
cases.failure: Duplicate username, invalid roles, self-suspend, self-demotion and lack of users.manage are denied; no self-signup.
cases.notes: Role assignment removes existing assignments then reinserts requested roles under a Sheets lock; mid-write interruption may leave a partial assignment and needs recovery plan.
cases.requirement: APPROVED_REQUIREMENTS_BASELINE_R01_R26.md (section-level mapping; no unverified R number asserted)

cases.title: Police hierarchy and external organization master
cases.pre: Authenticated reader has organizations.read; writes require organizations.manage; POLICE parent may be hierarchical; EXTERNAL remains flat.
cases.success: List active/disabled organizations; create POLICE or EXTERNAL records; update allowed fields; disable rather than silently delete.
cases.failure: Invalid org_type, missing parent, self-parent and unauthorized writes are rejected.
cases.notes: Source checks a direct self-parent but not arbitrary multi-level cycles; cyclic hierarchy prevention is a design-review gap.
cases.requirement: APPROVED_REQUIREMENTS_BASELINE_R01_R26.md (section-level mapping; no unverified R number asserted)

cases.title: System settings and public health check
cases.pre: Public health may be checked without credentials; settings require a server-verified SYSTEM_ADMIN session.
cases.success: Health returns minimal status; settings allow idle_timeout_minutes (1–480) and retention_days (1–3650), audit writes.
cases.failure: Unauthorized get/update, unsupported keys, invalid integer ranges are denied; health must not disclose secrets.
cases.notes: Health is special public route in Router, not one of 49 protected DTO handler operations.
cases.requirement: APPROVED_REQUIREMENTS_BASELINE_R01_R26.md (section-level mapping; no unverified R number asserted)

cases.title: Create, list and revoke registration campaigns
cases.pre: Authenticated System Admin with campaigns.manage; request includes start/end and submission limit.
cases.success: Store campaign token digest, schedule window and max quota; return raw token once to Admin; revoke invalidates subsequent use.
cases.failure: Invalid period/capacity, non-admin creation, reuse of revoked token denied.
cases.notes: Raw campaign token is returned only at creation; do not put in logs, analytics or referrer-bearing links.
cases.requirement: APPROVED_REQUIREMENTS_BASELINE_R01_R26.md (section-level mapping; no unverified R number asserted)

cases.title: Validate a public registration campaign token
cases.pre: Registrant opens a campaign URL with opaque token; a campaign has been created by System Admin.
cases.success: Server checks digest, ACTIVE status, start/end window, revocation and available quota; returns validity without privileged data.
cases.failure: Malformed, unknown, expired, revoked or full campaign token returns CAMPAIGN_INVALID.
cases.notes: Validation is advisory before form submission; actual quota check repeats inside registrations.submit under ScriptLock.
cases.requirement: APPROVED_REQUIREMENTS_BASELINE_R01_R26.md (section-level mapping; no unverified R number asserted)

cases.title: Upload five staged vehicle photos
cases.pre: Active campaign token; image JPEG/PNG/WebP with allowed signature, MIME and size; five slots FRONT, REAR, LEFT, RIGHT, FRONT_ANGLE.
cases.success: Create Drive file and vc_photo_staging metadata; return photoId/slot for subsequent registration.submit.
cases.failure: Invalid MIME/signature/slot, revoked campaign, staging quota or failed Sheet write triggers safe failure and best-effort Drive trash.
cases.notes: Upload occurs before acquiring Sheets lock; if cleanup trash fails an orphan may remain and needs reconciliation. Parent-folder Anyone-with-link exposure is an accepted risk in approved requirements.
cases.requirement: APPROVED_REQUIREMENTS_BASELINE_R01_R26.md (section-level mapping; no unverified R number asserted)

cases.title: Vehicle application submission with five photos
cases.actor: Registrant or assisted REGISTRATION_ADMIN with valid campaign
cases.pre: Campaign active with available quota; organization active; all mandatory vehicle/contact fields present; exactly five staged photo IDs. Assisted intake may load canonical references with vehicle.registration.approve.
cases.success: Store PENDING_APPROVAL registration, claim media, increment quota once, persist idempotency response and operation journal.
cases.failure: Duplicate plate+province, invalid campaign, staged photo mismatch, quota exhaustion or idempotency conflict denied; caught write errors compensated but abrupt timeout requires manual recovery.
cases.notes: Exactly one primary contact is created only during approval. Sheets compensation is not atomic database rollback; journal PREPARED after crash is a release blocker.
cases.requirement: APPROVED_REQUIREMENTS_BASELINE_R01_R26.md (section-level mapping; no unverified R number asserted)

cases.title: Administrator review, approval or rejection of vehicle registration
cases.pre: Registration request exists as PENDING_APPROVAL; Registration Admin has vehicle.registration.approve; readable plate photo manually verified for APPROVE.
cases.success: APPROVE creates ACTIVE vehicle, one primary contact, five active photo records, QR token digest and audit; REJECT only updates request and audit.
cases.failure: Insufficient approval permission, unreadable plate, duplicate active vehicle, already-reviewed request denied; mid-approval Sheets failure needs reconciliation.
cases.notes: The backend checks platePhotoVerified boolean supplied by admin session; actual human visual verification is outside code and requires UAT. Current approve path performs multiple Sheets writes without full durable compensation.
cases.requirement: APPROVED_REQUIREMENTS_BASELINE_R01_R26.md (section-level mapping; no unverified R number asserted)

cases.title: Authorized cross-org plate search, admin registry browse, details and contact/photo disclosure
cases.actor: STAFF / REGISTRATION_ADMIN with permissions; SYSTEM_ADMIN / REGISTRATION_ADMIN for admin registry (vehicle.list)
cases.pre: Valid server session; permissions vehicle.lookup, vehicle.contact.read, vehicle.photos.read and optionally vehicle.history.read; vehicle ACTIVE. Admin registry browse requires vehicle.list (SYSTEM_ADMIN / REGISTRATION_ADMIN only).
cases.success: Search normalized Thai plate+province across organizations; show permitted contact and 5 photo references with lookup audit; allow user-initiated phone dial. Admin registry (vehicles.list) browses all ACTIVE vehicles with minimal non-PII fields (no owner id, no contacts), paginated, no cross-sheet join.
cases.failure: Unknown/inactive vehicle, missing permission, revoked session or ambiguous active duplicate fail safely; don't expose public contact directory.
cases.notes: Approved business baseline permits immediate contact/5-photo visibility to authorized staff, no reason prompt. Images may be link-accessible outside app because of shared parent folder risk. C6 adds admin-only vehicles.list registry (permission vehicle.list, SYSTEM_ADMIN/REGISTRATION_ADMIN only, minimal non-PII fields, ACTIVE filter, no join); see backend/gas/tests/admin-vehicle-list.test.mjs (REG-01..05) and VC-ADR-017.
cases.requirement: APPROVED_REQUIREMENTS_BASELINE_R01_R26.md (section-level mapping; no unverified R number asserted)

cases.title: Direct authorized vehicle or primary contact correction
cases.pre: Vehicle ACTIVE, Registration Admin has vehicle.update, expectedVersion equals persisted version for vehicles.update.
cases.success: Apply permitted vehicle fields or primary contact changes; version increment and change audit; ownership can be assigned only to ACTIVE user.
cases.failure: Stale version, duplicate plate+province, nonexistent owner, missing single primary contact or missing permission are rejected.
cases.notes: Vehicle update uses ScriptLock and optimistic version; contact update checks one primary active contact. Contact update is permission vehicle.update in deployed code.
cases.requirement: APPROVED_REQUIREMENTS_BASELINE_R01_R26.md (section-level mapping; no unverified R number asserted)

cases.title: Owner proposes a change; Registration Admin approves
cases.pre: Owner account authenticated and linked to ACTIVE vehicle via owner_user_id, or has explicit vehicle.update; Admin has vehicle.change.approve.
cases.success: Store proposed_delta PENDING with audit; review APPROVE patches authorized vehicle/contact fields and audit; REJECT leaves current vehicle data unchanged.
cases.failure: Unverified ownership, empty change, invalid contact phone, unauthorized approver or already-reviewed request denied.
cases.notes: Anonymous owner verification/claim procedure is NOT implemented. Existing Owner change submit derives identity from server session; campaign token alone does not grant owner edit.
cases.requirement: APPROVED_REQUIREMENTS_BASELINE_R01_R26.md (section-level mapping; no unverified R number asserted)

cases.title: Authenticated QR scan and resolve
cases.pre: Mobile scanner successfully decodes an opaque 64-character token; user has valid session and vehicle.lookup permission.
cases.success: Hash token, find ACTIVE QR and ACTIVE vehicle, append lookup audit, return only fields authorized by caller.
cases.failure: Malformed, unknown, revoked or cancelled QR fails without releasing private data; revoked lookup may return null.
cases.notes: QR token must contain no PII. Camera permission, real mobile scanning and QR deep-link route are future frontend/device acceptance.
cases.requirement: APPROVED_REQUIREMENTS_BASELINE_R01_R26.md (section-level mapping; no unverified R number asserted)

cases.title: Issue, revoke and rotate vehicle QR token
cases.pre: Authenticated actor with qr.manage; vehicle ACTIVE and at most one ACTIVE QR.
cases.success: Issue opaque token only if none active; rotate revokes old then creates new digest; revoke fails closed for older QR, audit mutations.
cases.failure: Two active QR conflict, issue with existing token, inactive vehicle, unauthorized mutation blocked.
cases.notes: Under Sheets lock old QR is revoked and new one inserted. If GAS times out between writes, recovery must handle state; no claim of ACID.
cases.requirement: APPROVED_REQUIREMENTS_BASELINE_R01_R26.md (section-level mapping; no unverified R number asserted)

cases.title: List or replace a registered vehicle photo
cases.pre: ACTIVE vehicle; permitted admin, existing exactly one ACTIVE photo row for chosen slot; valid replacement PNG/JPEG/WebP.
cases.success: Upload new file to Drive outside lock, swap metadata under lock, audit; trash old file after persistence.
cases.failure: Invalid slot/MIME, missing photo row, Drive upload error; on failed Sheet write trash new file best-effort; failed old-file cleanup journals follow-up.
cases.notes: Listing is covered by UC-VEH-01 as photos.list; outside-app Drive folder link access is an approved privacy risk that must be tested in UAT.
cases.requirement: APPROVED_REQUIREMENTS_BASELINE_R01_R26.md (section-level mapping; no unverified R number asserted)

cases.title: Cancel vehicle and list retention work due
cases.pre: Vehicle ACTIVE; Registration Admin has vehicle.update; retention_days configured; due listing requires retention.read.
cases.success: Mark vehicle INACTIVE, revoke ACTIVE QR tokens, create WAITING_RETENTION job; later due list excludes legal holds.
cases.failure: Unauthorized cancel, missing policy, already inactive vehicle, legal hold or not-due jobs excluded from due list.
cases.notes: Baseline envisions DELETION_PENDING_APPROVAL + notification trigger; current implementation creates WAITING_RETENTION and lists due jobs but does not implement the notification scheduler. Explicit gap.
cases.requirement: APPROVED_REQUIREMENTS_BASELINE_R01_R26.md (section-level mapping; no unverified R number asserted)

cases.title: Retention approval, worker deletion and job status
cases.pre: Retention job due; legal_hold false; System Admin approves; worker receives retention.worker permission; destructive deletion explicitly enabled in isolated staging only.
cases.success: Approve status and audit; worker trashes Drive files, deletes related Sheets rows, keeps required change/lookup audit; job DELETION_COMPLETED.
cases.failure: Not due, hold, missing approver, disabled worker flag, storage fault produces retry-required; partial deletion reconciliation and idempotent retries still incomplete.
cases.notes: Deletion first trashes Drive then mutates multiple Sheets tables; abrupt interruption and repeated file trash calls can leave DELETION_FAILED and need verified reconciliation.
cases.requirement: APPROVED_REQUIREMENTS_BASELINE_R01_R26.md (section-level mapping; no unverified R number asserted)

cases.title: Restricted lookup/change audit query and JSON export
cases.pre: Active server session and audit.read permission; optional vehicleId scoped filter and bounded limit.
cases.success: Read vc_lookup_audit + vc_change_audit, combine and sort by timestamp; export JSON structure with capped rows.
cases.failure: Unauthorized actor, malformed limit or revoked session denied; never include raw tokens/passwords or unredacted secrets.
cases.notes: Current audit exporter returns JSON DTO (not a downloadable file). Audit append-only immutability and independent retention need further verification.
cases.requirement: APPROVED_REQUIREMENTS_BASELINE_R01_R26.md (section-level mapping; no unverified R number asserted)
